name: Skip Step 2 · keep baseline image
hypothesis: Preserve the v000 Step 1 mask, ROI, canvas, and JPEG path exactly, but pass that Step 1 output directly to the waviness regressor. This isolates the quality and latency impact of removing Step 2 segmentation and its downstream crop operations.
changes: Keep Step 1 full-resolution mask expansion, erosion, bounding box, masking, and crop behavior unchanged.
Keep the Step 1 224 × 224 canvas and JPEG encode/decode unchanged.
Skip Step 2 segmentation, its mask processing, lower-water crop, and second canvas/JPEG round trip.
Feed the decoded Step 1 image through the baseline final tensor preparation and regressor inference.

quality_policy.gate: same cohort, no failures, and no MAE, RMSE, or per-photo absolute-error regression
